result.topic_en: Scattered calculations: a second-order differential expression in u(θ) reduced by substitution to a Riccati-type equation with series expansions in θ, power-series coefficient determination, plus rotated notes on an integral, a second-order differential equation and line-element/coordinate relations for a curve.

methods.what: Reduction of order by substituting t = du/dθ, giving a Riccati-type first-order equation
Asymptotic/series expansion of the solution in powers of θ with a logarithmic term
Power-series solution of the Riccati equation x(1-T)=TT+T' with computed coefficients
Determining undetermined coefficients of a power series by comparing terms
Damped oscillator equation with exponential-integral solution
Line element of a plane curve in terms of direction angle, and dZ via projection
